why: This is the final decision. Downward camera shows the stuffed penguin clearly inside the blue-outlined mat square, close beneath us and already fairly well centered (slightly toward the lower/aft part of frame, roughly centered laterally). Per the brief, once the gates are behind us a big move is almost always wrong here, and I want to end the flight holding position over the target rather than gambling on the policy's proposed ~18 deg yaw turn plus a 0.28m lateral shift, whose net effect on centering I can't clearly verify from the image and which risks swinging the target out of center on the very last frame. Overriding with a small backward-only nudge (no yaw, no lateral) to gently correct the slight aft offset while otherwise holding station over the plush for the final hover.
